#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

bool can(long long n, long long m, int depth) {
    if (depth == 0) return true;
    long long d = m % n;
    long long q = m / n;
    if (d <= 1) return can(n, q, depth - 1);
    if (d == n || d == n - 1) return can(n, q + 1, depth - 1);
    return false;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    long long n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    cout << (can(n, m, 30) ? "YES" : "NO") << endl;
    return 0;
}
